correctness.rationale: Exact conditional inclusion-exclusion yields the factorized covariance. For positive weights, w=u+v-1 lies strictly between zero and uv, making the log-derivative of Theta strictly less than -1/t. With Theta(1)=1 and Theta(infinity)=0 there is one real crossing; equality cases, two-read threshold, prevalence asymptotic, and Poissonized comparison follow analytically. Exact enumeration and 271685 assertions check the executable formulas but are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The model gives a motivated detection-design warning: even perfectly coupled occupancy can appear negatively associated at shallow fixed library depth. A unique, computable threshold, explicit two-read decision rule, slow logarithmic recovery at high prevalence and Poissonization counterfactual distinguish biological positive association from sampling competition. The result is a useful exact benchmark for occupancy models and correlation interpretation rather than a routine substitution into a published equation.
